title: Effective Vibecoding
description: How to direct an AI coding agent well: scoping tasks, prompting clearly, reviewing what it writes, and staying safely in control the whole time.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 27 decks, 194 cards, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
